project.name: Pawprint
project.summary: Dog owners book and pay for walks with local walkers, and walkers keep track of their day. Planned from the PRD; nothing is built yet.

nodes.label: Customer website
nodes.summary: Where owners find a walker, book and pay, and manage their walks.

nodes.label: Walker app
nodes.summary: Where walkers see today's walks and mark them done.

nodes.label: Main server
nodes.summary: Answers both apps, takes payments and keeps the data.

nodes.label: Endpoints
nodes.summary: Everything the apps and Stripe can ask the server to do.

nodes.label: Saved data
nodes.summary: Reads and saves accounts, walkers and bookings.

nodes.label: Reminders
nodes.summary: Emails owners the evening before a walk.

nodes.label: Database
nodes.summary: Postgres, where accounts, walkers and bookings are kept.
